title: Coinbase Returns to India After 2-Year Pause, Fiat Access Coming 2026
summary: Coinbase has resumed operations in India following a two-year withdrawal, currently offering crypto-to-crypto trading while working toward fiat currency integration by 2026 after securing Financial Intelligence Unit approval. The post Coinbase Returns to India After 2-Year Pause, Fiat Access Coming 2026 appeared first on Cryptonews .
